hints.title: Smallest Stick Placement Case
hints.text: Consider the position of the shortest stick of length 1 among the n sticks.

hints.title: Front vs Non Front Transitions
hints.text: If the shortest stick is placed at index 0, it is visible; if placed anywhere else, it is hidden by taller sticks.

hints.title: Stirling Number Recurrence
hints.text: dp[n][k] equals dp[n - 1][k - 1] plus (n - 1) * dp[n - 1][k] modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all n! permutations is infeasible for n = 1000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stirling numbers of the first kind compute state transitions in O(n * k) table entries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate analyzes the shortest or tallest stick placement to deduce the recurrence.
